title: Google Deepens AI Integration Across Workspace — Hiring Surge for Prompt Engineers
summary: Google has announced a sweeping integration of Gemini AI models into Google Workspace, Drive, Gmail, and Meet. The rollout is driving a wave of new job postings across the industry for Prompt Engineers, AI Product Managers, and LLM fine-tuning specialists. Hiring managers report a 3x increase in AI-related roles compared to Q1 2024.

title: TCS and Infosys Announce Largest Campus Hiring Drive of 2025 — 80,000 Freshers Targeted
summary: India's top IT service firms Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) and Infosys have announced a combined campus hiring drive targeting 80,000 fresh graduates across India for fiscal year 2026. Preferred profiles include Computer Science, Electronics, and Mathematics graduates with strong fundamentals in Python, SQL, and data structures. Both companies will heavily test problem-solving via online assessments.

title: AWS Certifications Now the Single Biggest Resume Differentiator in Cloud Roles — Survey
summary: A new LinkedIn Talent Insights survey across 12,000 cloud job postings reveals that AWS certifications — specifically the AWS Solutions Architect (Associate) and AWS DevOps Professional — have become the single most impactful resume differentiator for cloud engineering roles in 2025. Certified candidates are being offered 22% higher starting salaries and are 4x more likely to receive interview callbacks.

title: Microsoft Lays Off 6,000 Employees — Mostly in Middle Management, Not Engineering
summary: Microsoft has announced a workforce reduction of approximately 6,000 employees, representing under 3% of its total headcount. Notably, the cuts are concentrated in middle management, program management, and sales coordination roles — not in core engineering or AI research teams. CEO Satya Nadella confirmed that investment in AI infrastructure and developer tools remains at full throttle for 2025.

title: Freshworks Expands Chennai R&D Centre — 2,000 New Engineering Jobs Open This Quarter
summary: Freshworks, the SaaS unicorn founded in Chennai, has announced a major expansion of its Chennai R&D headquarters. The company will add 2,000 new engineering roles across backend development, ML platform engineering, DevOps, and product design. CEO Dennis Woodside highlighted Freshworks' commitment to India as its primary engineering hub, with competitive compensation packages designed to attract senior talent from global MNCs.

title: Python Overtakes Java as the #1 Required Language in Indian Tech Job Postings
summary: According to an analysis of over 200,000 Indian job postings on LinkedIn and Naukri, Python has officially overtaken Java as the most frequently required programming language in tech roles for the first time. The shift is attributed to the explosive growth of data science, machine learning, and automation roles. Java retains dominance in enterprise backend roles, but Python's versatility across web, AI, and scripting is making it the default language for modern teams.

title: Accenture's AI Skilling Initiative to Upskill 300,000 Employees in Generative AI by 2026
summary: Accenture has launched 'LearnVantage AI', an internal initiative to upskill 300,000 of its global workforce in generative AI tools, prompt engineering, LLM fine-tuning, and AI ethics by end of 2026. The company has partnered with Microsoft, Google, and AWS for certification tracks. Accenture executives say clients are increasingly demanding AI-native delivery teams, making this skilling investment strategically critical.

title: India's IT Sector Sees 18% Salary Hike for Data Engineers in 2025 — Report
summary: The annual Mercer-Naukri Salary Benchmark Report reveals that Data Engineers in India received an average salary increment of 18% in 2025 — the highest across all tech roles. This spike is fueled by massive demand for real-time data pipelines, data lake architecture, and cloud data warehouse expertise (Snowflake, Databricks). Mid-level data engineers (3–6 years) are seeing the steepest jumps, with Bengaluru and Hyderabad leading the market.

title: Flipkart Launches 'Flipkart Labs' — A 500-Person Applied AI Research Division
summary: Flipkart has announced the launch of Flipkart Labs, a new applied AI research and engineering division focused on building proprietary AI systems for recommendation engines, supply chain optimization, fraud detection, and conversational commerce. The division will eventually grow to 500 researchers and engineers. This positions Flipkart as a serious tech R&D player, not just an e-commerce operator, directly competing for top AI/ML talent with Amazon and Google.

title: The Rise of the T-Shaped Developer: Why Full Stack + One Specialization is the New Career Gold Standard
summary: Hiring managers across top tech companies — from Zoho to Adobe — report a new talent demand pattern in 2025: the 'T-shaped developer'. This means hiring engineers who have broad full-stack web development skills (HTML, CSS, JS, React, Node.js) combined with deep expertise in one vertical: AI/ML, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, or mobile. Pure front-end and pure back-end specialists are being screened out more frequently in favour of this more versatile profile.
